## Hypothesis

H1: Respondents who spent most of their childhood in France rate infidelity as less morally wrong than respondents raised elsewhere.

H2: Respondents who spend more time per day on their appearance are more jealous about their partner's sexual infidelity.

```{r load package}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)

```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data
h1Data <- read.csv("Data/processed_data/project_h1.csv")
h2Data <- read.csv("Data/processed_data/project_h2.csv")

#reorganize categorical variable
h1Data$raisedFrance <- factor(h1Data$raisedFrance,
                              levels = c("France","Elsewhere"))

```

## H1 - Raincloud Plot

```{r H1Raincloud}
#Raincloud Plot
#A raincloud combines a half-violin, a box plot, and individual responses.
h1Rain <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                aes(x=raisedFrance,
                    y=infmoral_sex,
                    fill=raisedFrance)) +
  labs(x="Country where the individual was raised",
       y="Moral wrongness of sexual infidelity (from 1 to 7)",
       title ="Moral wrongness of sexual infidelity by country raised",
       fill ="") +
  theme_minimal(base_size =8)+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold")) +
  geom_rain(alpha=.5,
            likert=TRUE,
            point.args = list(alpha = .05, size = .5))

h1Rain

```

## H2 - Scatter Plot

```{r H2Scatter}

#Jitter
h2Jitter <- ggplot(data=h2Data,
                  aes(x=appearTime,
                      y=jealsex)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.12, alpha = 0.15, size=.6) +
  labs(x="Daily time spent enhancing appearance (in minutes)",
       y="Jealousy about partner's sexual infidelity (from 1 to 7)",
       title = "Relationship between appearance time spent and jealousy") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))


h2Jitter


```

## H2 - Smooth Line

```{r}
#Scatter Plot with line
h2Line <- h2Jitter + geom_smooth(method = "lm")

h2Line
```

## Save figures

```{r saveFigures}
#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.
dir.create("Figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("Figures/H1_figre_rainCloud.png", plot = h1Rain, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figures/H2_figures_line.png", plot = h2Line, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
